video_title: Warriors' Gui Santos & Will Richard Talk Offseason

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos details his intensive offseason training regimen
quotes.excerpt: Everything you can imagine, most like physical stuff on a basketball court too
quotes.quote: Everything you can imagine, most like physical stuff on a basketball court too, like all the, you know, get better and everything you can't imagine, you know, free throws, three-point shots, mid-range, layups, everything you can't imagine. Been watching my guy Will hooping too and some of the, it was good, you know.

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos on the stability provided by his NBA contract
quotes.excerpt: the stability the contract gives you is different
quotes.quote: For me, the guy that got drafted in the second round and you got the stability the contract gives you is different. But that don't change who I am, how I work, and what I do on the court to get better. But of course, that gives you a good, you know, a good, just to just be more ready for everything and you know that everything is right there.

quotes.speaker: Will Richard
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Richard on the Warriors' collective mindset for next season
quotes.excerpt: it's an opportunity for everybody to take a step up
quotes.quote: Knowing our team, we know we didn't accomplish what we wanted to last year, but it's an opportunity for everybody to take a step up and kind of provide something a little extra to get us in a position where we can succeed at a high level next year. We all know that we're capable of doing a lot more than we did, so definitely just want to come back with the right mentality, just trying to win at a high level next year.

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos attributes last season's struggles to team injuries
quotes.excerpt: we had a lot of injuries, that was a big thing that hold us back
quotes.quote: Last year we had a lot of injuries, that was a big thing that hold us back a little bit. This summer as soon as we got everybody healthy, everybody together, we were rolling as a team together when everybody was healthy. As soon as we got everybody healthy this year, I hope that we can keep playing at the high level like we were doing last season.

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos on Steve Kerr's return to the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: he's the guy that taught me a lot of stuff that I know in basketball
quotes.quote: I didn't know nothing, and as soon as I saw the post that he got, you know, the two-year deal with the Warriors, I was so happy because he's the guy that taught me a lot of stuff that I know in basketball. I learned a lot with him being my coach, and also to have him back for two more years with us is nice.

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos on the Warriors' team chemistry and future potential
quotes.excerpt: we basically have the same team, I think we have the same mentality
quotes.quote: We basically have the same team, Steve is still with us, so I think we have the same mentality. We just got to compete in the high level until we got Jimmy back, until we got Moses back, until we got our everybody healthy again. And as soon as we got everybody healthy again in the team, that's going to be a huge jump for us and, you know, just trying to get back playing in the high level like we were doing before everybody got hurt.

quotes.speaker: Will Richard
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Richard on the impact of Kristaps Porzingis
quotes.excerpt: he can space the floor, he can shoot it so well, so it creates a lot of space
quotes.quote: It's great playing with a guy like Kristaps Porzingis. He's tall, can space the floor, he can shoot it so well, so it creates a lot of space, can make reads, can make passes and stuff like that. And on the other end, he blocks shots, can guard multiple positions and stuff like that, can switch and still can guard. It's fun playing with a guy like that, he knows how to play the right way and he's about the right thing.
